name: Generated-image detector (GAN and diffusion)
corpus: Sample of the Community Forensics evaluation set (CompEval; 21 generators held out from training, 20 present here) downloaded 2026-10-15: 38 shards, 4,769 images (1,866 generated, 2,903 real from LAION, ImageNet, FFHQ and COCO). CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 data, used only to measure; not shipped.

detection.task: Was the whole image made by a generative model (diffusion, GAN, other)?
detection.positives: 1866 generated images from 20 generators unseen in training
detection.note: Real images in the sample are mostly JPEG and generated ones mostly PNG; the 'jpeg 90' and 'jpeg 75' conditions re-encode both alike, so they show accuracy without that format cue.

known_failure_modes: Generators released after the model was trained (late 2024) can be missed, and some commercial ones already are: Firefly Image 3 (35 %), Hourglass (38 %), Midjourney 6.1 (45 %), Firefly Image 2 (52 %) and Ideogram 2 (65 %) are detected far less often than open diffusion models and GANs (94-100 %). A low score on a modern commercial image means little.

JPEG re-compression and down-scaling lower detection (84 % as given, 72 % after JPEG 90, 64 % after JPEG 75, 73 % at half size) while false alarms stay under 1 %; generated images already stored as JPEG were detected in only 47 % of cases.
Scores the whole image: a generated object pasted into a real photograph, or an inpainted region, is usually not detected.
Heavily processed real photos (phone night modes, beautification, strong denoising or upscaling) can score as generated.
